title: An Evaluation of the Neuromuscular Junction in Neonates Using the TetraGraph
official: An Evaluation of the Neuromuscular Junction in Infants Using Train-of-four Monitoring With the TetraGraph™ Neuromuscular Transmission Monitor
summary: The goal of this study is to use electromyography-based train-of-four monitoring (TetraGraph™ Neuromuscular Transmission Monitor) as a means of evaluating differences in neuromuscular transmission between infants ≤ 3 months of age and adolescent and older patients (≥ 12 years of age).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASA 1-3 patients
* Aged 28 days - 3 months or ≥ 12 years
* Undergoing a surgical procedure with a volatile-agent based anesthetic that does not require administration of a neuromuscular blocking agent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with history of a peripheral neurologic or neuropathic disorder
* Patients in whom the upper extremity cannot be used for TOF monitoring
* Patients undergoing a surgical procedure in which neuromuscular blockade is required
* Edematous patients
* Patients receiving total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA)
